title: お正月の和の飾り罫
lead: 松竹梅・鶴亀・羽子板・だるまなど、お正月のモチーフを並べた区切り線12点です。年賀状の見出し下やおせちの案内の区切りに使える横長素材です。
subject_en: Horizontal decorative divider lines, each ONE wide thin strip about 6:1 in shape, centred in its cell with space around, made of repeating small motifs along a line. Strips are separate and never touch each other. Japanese traditional style with indigo, vermilion and gold. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a line of pine, bamboo and plum blossoms
a line of cranes and turtles
a line of hagoita paddles and shuttlecocks
a line of small daruma dolls
a line of kadomatsu pine decorations
a line of plum blossoms on a branch
a line of red and white mizuhiki knots
a line of overlapping seigaiha wave patterns with small gold dots
a line of small kagami-mochi with oranges
a line of rising sun and Mount Fuji silhouettes
a line of auspicious treasures: coins, mallets and scrolls
